title: Chain Sword
description: A simple mod that adds a chain sword to the game
body:
![How to craft the sword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a42e1455160b7dfa7f9f2bc88237057d853b04d1.jpeg)![How to craft the sword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3d5846e6fb82dbc958582cb0e7e3a0c25fd83a89_0.webp)Chain Sword Mod
Description:
The Chain Sword is a powerful new tool for your Minecraft adventures. Forged from iron chains, this weapon is crafted just like a standard sword, making it easy to integrate into your survival journey.

Features:

Crafting: Easily crafted using iron chains in the standard sword pattern.

Combat Mechanics: Designed to dominate in battle; each hit knocks back your enemies and launches them into the air, giving you the tactical space you need.

Stats: Deals 4 damage points per hit
